title: install-day-sprint-notelets-nov-2026
content:
Install day quick capture - notes / tiny incidents / actions (raw, unpolished)

Date: 2026-11-01 (install day), quick update captured during post-shift sync. Intended audience: install engineers + SRE on-call.

Attendees: Maya (install lead), Ethan (network), Lina (agent/telemetry), Omar (customer liaison), remote: Priya (security consult)

Summary:
- Customer: Polaris Health (staging -> prod cutover planned). Two parallel install threads: VPC peering + onprem edge appliances. Overall progress 70% done at EOD.
- Major visible incidents today: short VLAN mismatch causing gateway flaps; expired BMC firmware on one OOB node; TLS cert pinning failure on agent during first handshake with customer KMS endpoint.

Detailed notes / timeline:
- 08:30 - preflight check: found netplan config on node-12 with wrong gateway (10.1.0.1 instead of 10.1.1.1). Quick mitigation: apply temp route, restarted redwood-agent. Customer still seeing intermittent packet drops to controller (ticket JIRA-PD-1982).
- 09:10 - BMC console for rack03 reported firmware v1.2.0 which lacks watchdog fixes. Omar coordinated with customer to schedule immediate in-band firmware update; ETA 4h. Marked as medium risk for reboot during rollout.
- 11:45 - TLS handshake failing when agent attempted to fetch customer KMS certs (error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority). Root cause: customer is using internal root that wasn't in our PKI bundle. Short-term workaround: added their root (provided via secure upload) into /etc/redwood/ca-bundle.pem on affected hosts, restarted service. Logged as JIRA-PD-2021.
- 14:20 - Autoscaling tests for dedicated pool A succeeded (baseline latency 75ms p50). However during sustained 100qps load we saw KV cache thrash on two machines (mem pressure + repeated slow GC in Java-based shim). Lina: collect jmap/jstack from pods and upload to /tmp/trace-archive; filing follow-up with runtime team (link to internal PR forthcoming).
- 16:00 - final cutover prep: router ACLs reviewed; Ethan flagged an asymmetry on ACL policy between staging and prod (missing return-path rule). Applied rule and smoke-tested.

Unresolved / open blockers: (things that need owner + timeline)
- BMC firmware update risk: Omar to confirm maintenance window with Polaris ops and provide rollback plan if reboot fails (owner: Omar, due: 2026-11-02 EOD).
- KMS PKI process: Security wants documented onboarding steps for adding customer roots to agent bundle (owner: Priya, due: 2026-11-05). This must include HSM/KMS trust boundaries.
- KV cache thrash: Need heap profile + GC logs; runtime team wants reproducible load pattern. Lina to attach load script + logs to JIRA (owner: Lina, due: 2026-11-03).
- Service account perms: noticed redwood-agent role lacked kms:Decrypt on one IAM profile — intermittent failures observed. IAM owner (SRE) to patch role (owner: Ethan, due: 2026-11-02 morning).

Action items (short, actionable):
- Omar: confirm firmware window + escalate to hardware vendor if OTA fails (JIRA-PD-1982).
- Lina: gather Java heap dumps, upload to PD-traces, and ping runtime eng (JIRA-PD-2034).
- Maya: consolidate install-day checklist with mitigations and circulate to stakeholders (Confluence link draft).
- Ethan: push ACL reconciliation script to repo and add to runbook; include diff output for today's change.
- Priya: write short PKI onboarding checklist + required audit steps for customer-provided CAs.

Notes to self / quick heuristics observed:
- When customer uses internal CAs, ask for root bundle ahead of time and automate CA ingestion (small script: /ops/bin/ingest-customer-ca).
- Preflight should include BMC firmware version: add check to preflight scanner (cheap win).
- Network teams often forget return-path rules when translating between VPCs; add ACL comparison step in the runbook.

Links / refs (to paste in convo):
- JIRA-PD-1982 (VLAN/gateway mismatch)
- JIRA-PD-2021 (KMS cert pinning)
- Confluence: /display/PD/Polaris+Install+Notes (draft)
- Slack: #pd-field-ops thread on 2026-11-01 (notes + partial logs)

Observability snippets (copied logs):
- redwood-agent: 2026-11-01T09:05:42Z WARN handshake: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
- kernel: Nov 01 08:31:12 node-12 kernel: net_dev_watchdog: eth0 transmit queue timeout

Follow-up meeting: quick sync tomorrow 2026-11-02 09:00 PST (15 minutes) — purpose: unblock firmware + IAM fix + confirm runtime trace availability.

Misc (brainstorm / rough):
- Could we offer a tiny preflight SaaS check for customers to run before install? A lightweight agent that checks BMC versions, CA presence, ACL symmetry. Worth prototyping.
- Long term: make CA onboarding part of the customer onboarding checklist in Console (toggle, upload root, verify).

End of raw notes. Will clean into a formal after-action for the install playbook once owners update JIRA and we have firmware window confirmed.

- Maya
